title: iPad Pro reviews are starting to come in, and Apple's new tablet apparently won't replace your laptop (AAPL)
text: iPad Pro reviews are starting to come in, and Apple's new tablet apparently won't replace your laptop (AAPL) Monday, 5 November 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) The first wave of reviews of Apple's iPad Pro reviews published on Monday, and so far, they're mixed. It seems as though Apple's powerful new tablet, which starts at $799, is a beautifully designed device with futuristic new features like USB-C charging and Face ID, but it's not quite a total replacement for your laptop just ...
